description: This file defines an internal class 'AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension' which provides support for returning IAsyncEnumerable<T> from Orleans grain methods. It manages enumerator states, handles asynchronous iteration, cleanup, disposal, and integrates with Orleans timers and context for efficient enumeration over grain data streams.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerableGrainExtension
classes.description: Supports async enumeration for Orleans grains, manages enumerator lifecycle, integrates with timers for cleanup, handles concurrent enumeration and disposal.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes all active enumerators and timers.

methods.name: RemoveExpiredAsync
methods.description: Removes and disposes enumerators that have expired.

methods.name: StartEnumeration
methods.description: Begins a new asynchronous enumeration with a specified request ID.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Moves the enumeration to the next element for a given request ID.

methods.name: MoveNextCore
methods.description: Core logic for advancing enumeration, handles synchronous and asynchronous move next operations.

methods.name: AwaitMoveNextAsync
methods.description: Awaiter for MoveNextAsync, handles timing, cancellation, and exceptions.

methods.name: RemoveEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Removes and disposes a specific enumerator by request ID.

methods.name: OnTerminateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup after enumeration completes or errors occur.

methods.name: DisposeEnumeratorAsync
methods.description: Disposes of a given enumerator, cancels tasks, and releases resources.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronous dispose method for the extension.
